cache_policy: Production cache unchanged; warmup and every measured request may populate cache. No cold-start claim.

metric_definitions.retrieval_s: backend expansion_s + search_rerank_s (includes context fitting/metadata work timed in that stage)
metric_definitions.generation_s: backend answer stream until model stop or application stop; not decode-only
metric_definitions.citation_s: Must be zero: source summaries removed; numeric references still exist in main answer
metric_definitions.client_total_s: wall time for POST and complete JSON response; excludes resource sampler setup/teardown and file saving
metric_definitions.first_token_s: backend time to first raw draft token, including queue; not browser/client TTFT
metric_definitions.process_rss_mb: sum RSS unique backend/Ollama PIDs; conservative resident footprint, shared pages can be counted more than once
metric_definitions.status_ok: HTTP/response contract success, NOT answer correctness
metric_definitions.qa_cpu_core_seconds: sum of user+system CPU time deltas for unique QA PIDs; sample window includes small client/sampler overhead
metric_definitions.qa_cpu_mean_cores: QA core-seconds / sampled wall seconds; 1 means one logical CPU continuously occupied, not 1% of laptop
metric_definitions.peak_qa_gpu_single_device_mb: maximum per-device VRAM attributed to QA PIDs, no device-wide fallback

hardware_inventory.purpose: identitas alat ukur; BUKAN rekomendasi kapasitas server

resource_notes: Do not run other clients against the same backend/Ollama during a measurement.
Short-lived processes and peaks between samples may be missed.
GPU PID memory may be unavailable on Windows WDDM; missing is not zero.
Notebook/client CPU and host-wide CPU/RAM/GPU usage are excluded from resource estimates.
